title: Arc

sections.heading: History
sections.text:
During the Middle Ages, Arc's Ring belonged to Joan of Arc, showing her visions, which she became famous for. Before her death, she left the ring in the Paris Catacombs and protected it with a series of magical traps, including the Knights of Arc's Inner Circle. [S1E05] The Ring contained a powerful curse that stopped even the most elite of Seekers from sensing that it contains this Titan. [Divide and Conquer]

Centuries later, Sophie Casterwill used a powerful spell (Banebound) to contain the curse, allowing the Huntik team enough time to deliver Arc's Ring to the Cathedral of Notre Dame, a Huntik Foundation safehouse. Clements began running tests on it, but did not detect that Arc was, in fact, inside. [Divide and Conquer]

One year later, Arc became active and broke free from the Ring. She put Clements into a trance and took control of his Freelancer, Ironsquire and Hoplite Titans, causing them to run riot outside Notre Dame Cathedral and attack nearby tourists. The Huntik team fought and defeated the Titans, and ventured into the Catacombs where they found Clements by the Ring, in a dreamlike state. Hoping to save him by joining the dream, the team all touched Arc's Ring but were trapped in individual dreamworlds. 

Sophie found herself playing the queen of the Casterwill family and forced to play a fatal chess game against the Betrayer and his Spiral Demons, losing every member of her family. She was then shown the Red Comet hurtling through space. Meanwhile, Zhalia saw every Blood Spiral Silent Soldier as herself before being forced to become one herself. Lok saw every Titan of his become a Harlekin, including Cherit. His only mode of escape was to summon Pendragon to defeat the Titans, allowing him to escape from the dream and wake up. 

Once awake, Lok saw Arc for the first time and fought with her, powerbonding with Lindorm in their battle. Dante then awoke, and summoned Ariel who distracted Arc before Dante hit her with a Touchram, sending her back to her Amulet and releasing Sophie, Zhalia and Clements from their nightmares. Lok later theorized that if the Foundation could know the future, then they could get an advantage over the Blood Spiral. However, Clements stated that the Ring of Arc, doesn't give, it only takes, prompting Dante to tell him to seal it away, declaring the Ring contained nothing but sadness. When Lok asked him what happened in his dream, Dante sadly walked away. [The Legendary Titan of Fate]

Dante later returned to Master Storm in China, whom he had trained under as a child in order to undergo secret training in order to prepare to meet his fate that Arc had showed him. [S2E43] It was revealed that Dante's nightmare had shown his closest friends at his grave, mourning his death. [Lok's Leadership]

On the longest night of the year, Dante made the decision to sacrifice himself in order to save the world from the Red Comet and prevent the return of the Nullifiers. Before teleporting into space with Umbra, he revealed to the Betrayer that he knew his future after Arc showed it to him, and that, in his future, the Betrayer would lose. [The Spiral Mark]

sections.heading: Abilities
sections.text:
As the Legendary Titan of Fate, Arc possesses immense reality-warping and mental manipulation powers that make her a highly volatile and dangerous entity. She can bind with individuals, putting them into a state of physical paralysis and deep trance. [S2E34] Once inside a victim's mind, Arc can create hyper-realistic, tailored psychological dreamscapes that shows them their future, all the while feeding off their deepest real-world emotional traumas and fears. Her capability to view the future of a living person is said to not give its wielder any advantages, but instead only takes, leaving her chronological prophecies completely unstable and dangerous. [S2E34] Arc's curse is powerful enough to conceal herself from detection from high-level, elite Seekers, preventing them from sensing that the ring contains a Legendary Titan. [Divide and Conquer] 

In combat, Arc fly through the air and fire beams of psychic energy from her mind or blasts of orange lightning from her hands. However, unlike other Legendary Titans, she can only withstand a limited number of attacks before returning to her Amulet. [S2E34]

Arc is also able to independently trigger the invocation of a Seeker's Titans, and control them to carry out her will and attack others. Titans that are under her influence display glowing orange eyes, and will attack anyone they see including passing civilians. [S2E34] She is the only known Titan capable of invoking Titans without the need of a Seeker. [S2E34]
